Prefer individuals with a given value of a covariate

Source: R/rkn_criterion.R
rkn_criterion_level.Rd

Scores a candidate set of individuals by the proportion of its members whose covariate value equals level. Intended for dichotomous covariates, but works for any covariate type supporting ==.

Criteria are used by rkn_select_criteria: within each family, where several sets of unrelated individuals remain to choose from, each candidate set is scored and the best one is selected.

Usage

rkn_criterion_level(covariate, level)

Arguments

covariate

Character. Name of a vertex attribute of the network, such as "sex" for V(g)$sex.

level

The preferred value of covariate (matched with ==).

Value

An object of class c("rkn_criterion_level", "rkn_criterion").

See also

rkn_select_criteria, rkn_criterion_cutoff; rkn_select_global for a target composition of the whole selection.

Examples

# Prefer women
rkn_criterion_level("sex", "F")
#> <rkn_criterion: level>
#>   covariate: sex
#>   level: F
